intro: Looking for your next escape? Almaty delivers: a green city at the foot of snowy peaks. Here is everything you need to plan a trip.

sections.heading: Why visit Almaty
paragraphs: Almaty (Central Asia) is known for its mountain, city and nature experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is May to September, or December to March for skiing.

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Kolsai and Kaindy lakes make a great two-day trip.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Almaty?
faq.a: May to September, or December to March for skiing.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Almaty?
faq.a: Popular choices: City centre near Panfilov Park.
